## Notes

Youthcat Studio, published by Gamera Games; Windows early access 2021-01-21; single-player; drones move resources between factories across a star system; research matrices consumed by labs; Rise of the Dark Fog update (December 2023) added a hostile faction; developers drew inspiration from Stellaris Dyson spheres; 1.7 million sold by September 2021.
